borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Non-material amendments to planning permission Ref.2022/00949/FUL dated 13th July 2023 for the 'Erection of a part one/part two storey extension to the main building at roof level following removal of existing plant; plant enclosure at seventh floor level; three-storey tiered extension to the side and rear of the building at second, third and fourth floor levels; roof terraces at fifth and seventh floor levels; alterations to ground floor frontage and the first floor northern elevation; replacement windows; external alterations; provision of refuse storage at ground floor level and cycle storage at basement level, in connection with the provision of an additional 4,539sqm (GEA) of high grade Class E(g)(i) office space (16,301sqm (GEA) in total)'. Amendments sought are the accommodation of larger substations within the existing building envelope on the ground floor; alterations to doors at ground and second floor level in the northern elevation; repositioning of roof lights at first and second floor levels; brick detailing/infill added to parts of eastern, northern and southern elevations; wall added to riser at seventh floor level; smoke extracts added at roof level; new louvre for basement smoke extract added to ground floor window in the southern elevation; repositioning of louvres in western elevation at third floor level; alterations to window design to insert spandrel panels on western elevation; doors indicated on elevation drawings to reflect positions on approved floor plans.
